column1: # The Rust port's hand-decided names: old <TAB> new (new == old keeps the name).
# Words with more than one meaning, decided as in the C core.
# The exception-code variants share spellings with other enums' variants (Int is also a
# ScanValue), so the token pass keeps them and fix_rust_after_apply.py renames ExceptionCode::<v>.
# Kept: English words, the R/I/J formats, the grammar shapes, file descriptors (libc's pollfd),
# the syscall names (print_int, read_int), numeric helpers.
